name: Figma Dev Mode
description: Figma Dev Mode is Figma's developer-focused interface for inspecting design files, comparing versions, reviewing annotations and ready-for-development work, linking design nodes to code and tickets, and translating design intent into implementation.
agentUseSummary: Do not create a separate Figma Dev Mode connection or install. Connect the canonical Figma provider once, then use its bounded file, node, render, version, selection, variable, developer-resource, and comment REST operations under the existing Safe or Dangerously skip permissions policy. Relay does not expose in-editor code generation, VS Code plugins, Figma MCP, Ready-for-dev UI, or canvas writes through this alias.

blocked.label: Create a separate Figma Dev Mode connection
blocked.description: Dev Mode uses the same Figma user, OAuth grant, file keys, permissions, variables, developer resources, and API origin as the canonical Figma provider; a second connection would duplicate identity and authority.

blocked.label: Install duplicate Dev Mode tools
blocked.description: Relay mounts supported file-inspection and developer-handoff operations once through the canonical Figma provider rather than publishing parallel Dev Mode tools and policies.

blocked.label: Write to the Figma canvas
blocked.description: Figma's external REST API does not create, move, resize, restyle, or delete canvas nodes; Relay does not repurpose plugins, Figma MCP, browser sessions, or agent write-to-canvas features.

blocked.label: Run in-editor Dev Mode features
blocked.description: Inspect-panel plugins, code generation, VS Code integration, component playground, focus view, Ready-for-dev status UI, notifications, local selection events, and private partner APIs are outside Relay's REST runtime.

blocked.label: Administer Dev Mode or enterprise governance
blocked.description: Seats, plans, Dev Mode settings, organization policy, discovery, activity logs, AI metering, SCIM, billing, permissions, raw APIs, and broad ingestion are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Use Figma
approvalProfiles.description: No separate Dev Mode action is enabled because Dev Mode shares the canonical Figma provider and its supported REST file and developer-handoff boundary.

runtimeSupport.description: No duplicate Figma Dev Mode tools are mounted. OpenClaw uses the canonical Figma provider for supported bounded REST inspection and developer-resource workflows.
No duplicate Figma Dev Mode tools are mounted. Hermes uses the canonical Figma provider for supported bounded REST inspection and developer-resource workflows.

providerSetup.blocker: Figma Dev Mode is a developer-focused mode of Figma Design files, not a separate provider identity or authorization surface. A second provider card, OAuth grant, credential record, installation, policy, or runtime adapter would duplicate the existing Figma connection. Stable REST APIs cover selected file, variable, developer-resource, selection, and comment operations, while Dev Mode plugins, codegen, VS Code, Figma MCP, UI statuses, and canvas writes use different in-editor or separately authorized surfaces.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep this product-mode slug non-installable and direct setup, connection, installation, and supported execution to the canonical Figma provider. Use exact bounded file, node, render, version, selection, variable, developer-resource, and comment routes under the selected Figma connection and policy. Revisit additional Dev Mode behavior only if Figma publishes stable external REST endpoints and granular scopes for statuses, annotations, codegen, component mappings, focus data, or write-to-canvas, and Relay approves their exact customer authority and data contract.

evidence.supports: Figma defines Dev Mode as a developer-focused interface entered from a Figma Design file for inspection, versions, annotations, Ready-for-dev status, integrations, components, and code handoff.
Figma's REST Dev Resources API reads and manages developer-contributed URLs attached to nodes and displayed in Dev Mode under the normal file authority model.
Figma's Variables REST API provides bounded read and mutation operations with explicit Enterprise plan, seat, file-permission, and file-variable scope requirements.
Figma documents Dev Mode plugins as an in-editor read-only surface for inspection and code generation with current-page, UI, event, and VS Code semantics distinct from external REST integrations.
Figma's granular file, variable, developer-resource, selection, and comment scopes belong to one Figma authorization and remain subordinate to provider-side plan and resource permissions.
